hero.title: Running the event that grows the region.
hero.subtitle: We host the Wisconsin FTC Rookie Qualifier, a low-pressure first event for new teams. This year: 26 rookie teams, 3 new judges, and a partnership with Team 13201 Hazmat.

heroPhoto.caption: Event floor at the 2026 Wisconsin FTC Rookie Qualifier

impact.label: Why it matters
impact.text: Most rookie teams have never seen a real field before their first qualifier. We run one just for them, and everyone gets a shot at states.

approach.label: Our Approach
approach.heading: Why we run the qualifier
approach.body:
Wisconsin loses FTC teams every year to an overwhelming first qualifier. We've been there, so we fixed it.

It still runs to full FTC standards: real rankings, alliance selection, state slots. More support means friendly faces who get it.
